issues.label: Blinding in clinical trials
issues.reason: Omitted to avoid a cross-batch duplicate. Coordinator confirmed batch 007 owns double-blind studies; allocation concealment and intention-to-treat remain separately supported mechanisms.
Skin grafting is a sourced reconstructive method. It does not fit diagnostic methods, so its new subfield is explicit; all three assigned health starting subfields still have at least 14 proposals.

OpenStax physiological mechanism passages were inspected selectively. Do not reuse its paper-bag or diabetic-coma treatment remarks, broad insulin-receptor claims, active urea-pump wording, or clinical threshold advice. These are unnecessary to the selected learning takeaways and contain concerning simplifications or errors.

issues.label: Chesapeake Bay hypoxia case
issues.reason: The promising public discovery page returned failures on two attempts. Its search excerpt is retained in 045-environment-discovery.json but was not admitted as passage evidence. The inspected Sand Hollow field case fills the environmental case-study slot instead.

The Shenandoah source is used only for its inspected igneous-structure passages. Its broad ancient-supercontinent wording is not used. The oceanography resources landing pages were not treated as explanatory support; dedicated NOAA articles were inspected instead.

issues.detail: Coordinator confirmed batch 004 does not reserve the proposed food mechanisms or generic Emulsion control. Food owns these proposals subject to baseline review. Batch 006 owns Subak; no Subak identity is proposed here.

Horticultural grafting and skin grafting are separately sourced practices. Shared Graft wording is supported by the apple propagation and NHS tissue-transfer passages. Existing cambial alignment remains a narrower plant-grafting facet, not a synonym of either full practice.

Variable-rate manure application was dropped after two 429 responses; variable-rate irrigation was independently discovered and inspected. Park Grass landing page and a 2014 Swarna page each failed twice; an actual e-RA dataset and a different IRRI research account supplied support. Marker-assisted selection used UNL after a failed extension page and an inaccessible IRRI PDF. Failed sources are not explanatory evidence.

Water-activity source is historical and used for the physical definition, not current regulatory guidance. Chocolate-bloom evidence supports the fat-bloom form only. Pectin gelation retains formulation differences. No universal companion-planting benefit, indefinite flood survival or assumption that all saved seed breeds true is asserted.
